The bug reports about scheduled reports failing to send after a DST change on Safari 17 are:

- BUG-2006: Reports: Scheduled report fails to send on Safari 17-generated schedules created after a DST change (doc_type=bug_report, module=Reports, status=In Progress)  
- BUG-2001: Reports: Scheduled report fails to send on Chrome 128-generated schedules created after a DST change (doc_type=bug_report, module=Reports, status=Open) — *Note: This is on Chrome 128, not Safari 17*  
- BUG-2006 is the only one explicitly about Safari 17-generated schedules after DST change.

However, upon closer inspection of the cross-references and descriptions:

- BUG-2006: "Scheduled report fails to send on Safari 17-generated schedules created after a DST change" — this matches the query exactly.
- BUG-2001: "Scheduled report fails to send on Chrome 128-generated schedules" — not Safari 17.
- BUG-2006 is the only one that specifies Safari 17 and DST change.

Thus, only one bug report matches the query.

(Source: BUG-2006)
